pages.en:
March 5, 1941. Afternoon Translation

Chinese-American Daily News (brief comment) :-

WELCOME TO SIR ARCHIBALD CLARK KERR

In August last year, Sir Archibald Clark
Kerr, British Ambassador to China, left Shanghai for
Chungking. Yesterday he returned to Shanghai. Every
resident extends a warm welcome to the British Ambassador.
Sir Archibald has been called "a friend
of China". He has done much to help to China's
reconstruction through resistance. For instance, the
re-opening of the Yunnan-Burma Highway and the Britain's
loan of £10,000,000 to China were both due to his
assistance. During the past few months, he has remained
in China's Auxiliary Capital to maintain close contact with
the Chinese authorities. Every Chinese citizen,
therefore, feels a deep attachment for him.
The arrival of the British Ambassador in
Shanghai, where Britain has vast economic interests, at a
time when Japan is talking loudly about a southward
advance and Britain is making intensified preparations in
the Far East, is probably connected with some mission; it,
at least, indicates Britain's concern over Shanghai.
Sir Archibald never makes any statement
when he comes to Shanghai. So let us not indulge in
conjectures over the nature of his mission. We wish him
very good health.

1941年3月5日。下午译文

《中美日报》（简评）：-

欢迎阿奇博尔德·克拉克·克尔爵士

去年八月，英国驻华大使阿奇博尔德·克拉克·克尔爵士离开上海前往重庆。昨日他返回上海。各界人士向英国大使致以热烈欢迎。阿奇博尔德爵士被称为“中国之友”。他为协助中国通过抗战进行重建做了大量工作。例如，滇缅公路的重新开通以及英国向中国提供的1,000万英镑贷款，均得益于他的协助。在过去几个月里，他一直留在中国陪都，与中国当局保持密切联系。因此，每一位中国公民都对他怀有深厚的感情。
在日本大谈南进、英国在远东加强备战之际，英国大使抵达拥有巨大经济利益的上海，可能与其承担某项使命有关；这至少表明了英国对上海的关注。
阿奇博尔德爵士每次来上海从不发表任何声明。因此，我们不必对其使命性质妄加猜测。祝他身体健康。

FORM NO. 3
G. LUM-1-40

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. 137/40 (BⅣ)
                                Bubbling Well Station.
            REPORT              9263(C)
                                Date... Aug. 21st. 1940
Subject (in full)... Re Police Duties at No.50 Tunsin Road. Residence of H.E., Sir
            A. Clark Kerr, British Ambassador.
Made by       and           Forwarded by... Chief Inspector McFarlane.

Sir,
    In re when checking the duties, it was ascertained
from Mr. Maddox, Butler to His Excellency, that the latter
will take up residence at Cathay Hotel on his return from
Chungking (November 1940).
    Lady Kerr, who is on holiday in North China at
present, is due back in Shanghai on 20/9/40, and is
expected to reside with Mr. & Mrs. C.J. Cooke and family
at 19 Crescent Avenue (Yu Yuen Road).
    The house at No.50 Tunsin Road will be officially
vacated on 30/9/40, until then two C.P.Cs will be kept
on duty there (all shifts).
                                        I am,
                                            Sir,
                                        Yours obediently.
                                        J. McFarlane
                                        Officer-in-charge.

（批：copy for
D.C. Esp Br.）

                                静安寺捕房。
            报告              9263(C)
                                日期... 1940年8月21日
主题（全称）... 关于敦信路50号（Tunsin Road）的警务职责。英国大使阿·克拉克·克尔阁下寓所。
制作人       及           转发人... 总督察麦克法兰（McFarlane）。

先生，
    关于检查勤务一事，经从阁下管家马多克斯（Maddox）先生处获悉，后者将于从重庆返回后（1940年11月）入住华懋饭店（Cathay Hotel）。
    目前正在华北度假的克尔夫人，预计于1940年9月20日返回上海，并拟与C.J.库克（Cooke）夫妇及其家人一同居住在克雷森特大道19号（愚园路）。
    敦信路50号的寓所将于1940年9月30日正式腾空，在此之前，将有两名额外巡捕（C.P.Cs）在该处执勤（所有班次）。
                                        此致，
                                            先生，
                                        您顺从的仆人。
                                        J. 麦克法兰
                                        主管警官。

（批注：副本送
副总监 特别分部）

June 12, 1939.

D.C. (Special Branch).
- - - - - -

H.E. feels precautions are too obvious and
might lead to a photograph and ridicule.

I have told D.C. (Divisions) there must be only
one uniform man at outside of house and of office; others
in plain clothes.

Inside office building Uniform men not necessary
I think. "Following" escort party can go in advance into
the lobby and mark down suspects. Once in the lift, I
think the plan mentioned in my letter sufficient.

Please instruct D/S. Hyde to note items thought
excessive by H.E. and report same to you for adjustment.

(SGD.) K.M. BOURNE,

Commissioner of Police.

IW/.
pages.zh:
1939年6月12日。

副总监（特别分部）。
- - - - - -

阁下认为防范措施过于明显，可能会导致被拍照和嘲笑。

我已告知各区分部副总监，住宅和办公室外只能有一名穿制服的人员；其他人着便衣。

我认为在办公楼内部不需要穿制服的人员。“跟随”护卫队可以提前进入大厅并标记嫌疑人。一旦进入电梯，我认为我信中提到的计划就足够了。

请指示海德副督察记录阁下认为过度的事项，并向你报告以便调整。

（签名）K.M. 伯恩（BOURNE），

警务总监。

IW/.
